# 322. Coin Change

[LeetCode](https://leetcode.com/problems/coin-change/) · **Medium** · Pattern: [1-D Dynamic Programming](README.md) · [All patterns](../README.md) · [Home](../../README.md)

> **Key insight:** Unbounded knapsack: dp[a] = 1 + min(dp[a - coin]); use amount + 1 as infinity.

## Approach

1. Unbounded knapsack: dp[a] = 1 + min(dp[a - coin]); use amount + 1 as infinity.
2. Complexity: time `O(amount * coins)`, space `O(amount)`.

| | Complexity |
|---|---|
| Time | `O(amount * coins)` |
| Space | `O(amount)` |

## Solution

<!-- prep:solutions:start -->
<details>
<summary><b>Python</b> (spoiler) · <code>0322-coin-change.py</code></summary>

```python
from typing import List


class Solution:
    def coinChange(self, coins: List[int], amount: int) -> int:
        inf = amount + 1
        dp = [0] + [inf] * amount
        for a in range(1, amount + 1):
            for c in coins:
                if c <= a:
                    dp[a] = min(dp[a], dp[a - c] + 1)
        return dp[amount] if dp[amount] != inf else -1
```

</details>
<!-- prep:solutions:end -->
